issues.title: Jordan Condemns Houthi Attack on Madinah Power Station
issues.title_en: Jordan Condemns Houthi Attack on Madinah Power Station
issues.summary: Jordan condemned a Houthi militia drone attack targeting an electricity distribution station in Madinah, Saudi Arabia, describing it as a blatant violation of the Kingdom’s sovereignty and a threat to its security, stability and territorial integrity.
